en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Musa bin Mutawakkil, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Ibrahim bin Hashim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Adheena, from Muhammed bin Hukaym, from Maymun al-Baan, that he said: I heard Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,

whilst he was asked about the saying of Him, Exalted and Glorious is He: «He is the First and the Last» [57:3] to which he said: The First, not (in the sense) of a first before Him, nor of a beginning that preceded Him, and the Last, not (in the sense) of an end, as is conceivable about the characteristics of creatures. Rather, (He is) Ancient; a First and a Last, has not perished nor does perish, with no beginning nor end. No incidence occurs upon Him, nor does He change from one condition to another condition, the Creator of everything.
